recycling.notes: City DPW collects residential recycling weekly in covered carts, out by 7am. Trash is collected by private haulers, so there is no city trash day. No pickup on Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas. A street can appear twice when its segments differ; the layer has no house-number ranges.

items.name: CSWD Drop-Off Center in Burlington
items.district_notice: The Hinesburg Drop-Off Center is accessible only from Beecher Hill Road via Route 116, and the upper section of Beecher Hill Road (North Road side) is closed until further notice.
items.takes: Blue-bin recycling, food scraps, small special items; no trailers or large loads
